verdict.rationale: Intel's official 285K spec page lists OpenVINO, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX Runtime and WebNN as supported AI frameworks on the CPU. The oneAPI page documents oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations for LLM and image-generation inference on Core Ultra series 2 and Arc GPUs, and VTune profiling for Intel NPUs, so the vendor's own stack and ONNX Runtime both target this silicon. Missing for 10: any evidence of llama.cpp support, framework support listed per GPU/NPU engine (the spec list covers only the CPU), in-depth runtime docs beyond a spec-sheet line, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these runtimes run well on this chip.
